features.name: agy review commands confined to the repo
features.description: Spec docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-20-agy-review-paths-design.md. The nine prefix rules (cat, head, tail, grep, ls, wc, git status/rev-parse/merge-base) took any argument and any pipe: cat /etc/hosts, git diff -O /etc/hosts and git status | cat /etc/hosts ran live. AGY_REVIEW_ALLOW is now two command(regex:...) rules: no argument may start with /, ~ or = (zsh expands =ls to /bin/ls), have a .. path part or hold a glob; a quoted one may not start with - or contain ..; git ranges (HEAD~1..HEAD, main...HEAD) still pass. allow-agy removes the rules it retired (the prefix rules and older shapes of its own regex rules) and keeps the user's other rules.
acceptance_criteria: outside reads by absolute, home, =name, .. and glob paths are refused, quoted or not, in pipes too
ordinary review commands inside the repo and git ranges still run
allow-agy removes its retired rules and keeps the user's own
live agy run refuses the outside reads and runs the ordinary commands
features.evidence: Tests first: test_agy_review_commands_stay_inside_the_repo, test_agy_review_note_names_every_allowed_command and test_allow_agy_removes_the_rules_it_retired failed on the old rules; 209 passed, 1 skipped after. Mutations (leading / allowed, .. part allowed, retired rules kept) each fail a test. Live agy 1.4.3: 6 ordinary commands ran, 12 outside reads refused (cat /etc/hosts, cat '/etc/hosts', ls .., ls ~, ls .*, grep -c localhost /etc/hosts, git diff -O /etc/hosts, git status | cat /etc/hosts, git log -- /etc, head -c 20 =ls, git diff --stat =ls =cat, cat ../agytest/a.txt). Live allow-agy: 10 rules removed, 2 added, mode 600 kept. Two subagent reviews (security, correctness) both found zsh =name expansion (cat =ls read /bin/ls); fixed with a failing test. Correctness review also found the note misdescribing quoted arguments and allow-agy removing a user's own command(regex:^git (fetch|pull)$); both fixed, the latter with a failing test. No re-review: the fixes removed a character and narrowed three prefixes. Symlinks: none tracked point outside in the three repos; untracked pack-skill links point to skill folders. Refused now that ran before: grep long options (--include=), globs, quoted patterns with .. or a backslash. Same round: certifi 2026.10.19 for PYSEC-2026-4320 (4325a9c).
